sources.title: Role of maternal age and pregnancy history in risk of miscarriage: prospective register based study
sources.claim: 421,201 pregnancies; miscarriage risk lowest at 25-29 (10%), rising to 53% at 45 and over.
sources.quote: The risk of miscarriage was lowest in women aged 25-29 (10%) ... rose rapidly after age 30, reaching 53% in women aged 45 and over.

sources.title: Pregnancy outcomes among women near the end of reproductive age
sources.claim: Women 45+ vs 20-34: preeclampsia 17.5% vs 6.6%, gestational diabetes 19.0% vs 8.5%, cesarean 38.8% vs 16.9%, preterm birth 39.6% vs 14.5%.
sources.quote: the rates of preterm birth (39.6% vs. 14.5%; relative risk of 2.73, 95% CI: 2.14-3.47); Table 2: preeclampsia 17.5% vs 6.6%, GDM 19.0% vs 8.5%, cesarean 38.8% vs 16.9%
sources.checked_with: WebFetch PMC full text incl. Table 2, 2026-10-18

sources.title: One thousand seventy-eight autologous IVF cycles in women 45 years and older: the largest single-center cohort to date
sources.journal: Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Genetics
sources.claim: 1,078 fresh own-egg IVF cycles at 45+: clinical pregnancy 9.6% and live birth 3.4% per transfer; most live births at 45; none when 4 or fewer eggs retrieved.
sources.quote: overall clinical pregnancy rate per transfer was 9.6%, and the live birth rate per transfer was 3.4% ... no live births when 4 or fewer oocytes were retrieved
sources.checked_with: WebFetch Weill Cornell VIVO abstract record (PMID 29143944) 2026-10-18; PMC returned a captcha

sources.title: National trends and outcomes of autologous in vitro fertilization cycles among women ages 40 years and older
sources.journal: Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Genetics
sources.claim: US own-egg IVF cycles in women 40+ rose from 8,672 to 28,883 (1996-2013); share of all cycles from 16.0% to 21.0%.
sources.quote: increased from 8672 to 28,883 ... 16.0% in 1996 to 21.0% in 2013

sources.title: Trends and Outcomes for Donor Oocyte Cycles in the United States, 2000-2010
sources.claim: Donor oocyte cycles rose from 10,801 to 18,306 a year; recipient age was not associated with likelihood of a good perinatal outcome.
sources.quote: The annual number of donor oocyte cycles significantly increased, from 10 801 to 18 306 ... Recipient age was not associated with likelihood of good perinatal outcome.

sources.title: O-282 How many blastocysts are needed to ensure at least one euploid? The impact of maternal age and blastocyst quality on euploidy probability
sources.claim: 4,911 blastocysts: at age 44 euploidy probability 52.4% (grade A), 31.7% (B), 20.3% (C); 5, 8 and 13 blastocysts needed for at least one euploid.
sources.quote: At age 44 these probabilities drop to 52.4%, 31.7%, and 20.3%, respectively ... 5 (A), 8 (B), 13 (C)

sources.title: Optimizing natural fertility: a committee opinion
sources.claim: Relative fertility is about half at 40 vs late 20s/early 30s; Hutterite mothers' average age at last pregnancy just before 41; evaluation after 6 months without conception for women 35 and older.
sources.quote: Relative fertility is decreased by about half at age 40 ... average age of the mother at the last pregnancy just before turning 41 years old ... warranted after 6 months without conception for women aged 35 years and older

sources.title: First live births after adipose-derived stem cells and platelet-rich plasma intraovarian administration
sources.claim: Two women 45 and older had live births after intraovarian adipose-PRP: a 46-year-old with DOR conceived naturally six months later and delivered at 47; a 45-year-old with endometriosis and failed IVF conceived by FET from embryos made three months after treatment.
sources.quote: This report describes two women aged 45 and older who achieved live births following intraovarian administration ... Six months later, she conceived naturally and delivered a healthy infant at age 47.
